about: RESULT house look (fixed: one house look per style, small variation per reel). Artifacts follow the story; the look does not change.

type.captions: one or two words, Inter Tight, two-tier (small line + one big bold word)

artifacts_rule: an object from the story's world per beat; reuse is fine when the story calls for it
film: the speaker's face as shot (no sepia / warm grade unless the user asks: look.asked); grain + seeded dust, vignette
grade_rule: reference data only, never applied to the speaker's face: the footage stays as shot and the inserts are conformed to it; broll_qa.py as_shot fails a regraded plate
components_rule: the house look is the type, captions, accents, insert framing and the speaker's face as shot; phone-UI scenes, paper props, polaroid / card / collage treatments, transitions, hook and outro devices are NEW every reel (scripts/components.py plan / check / record, catalog.json)
